name: Grid List Toggle
description: Pair of toggle buttons whose icon morphs between a four-dot grid and a list of lines on click, one icon-only and one with a sliding Grid/List label.
contents: Dark toggle button with icon and Grid/List text label
behavior: Four dots shrink and shift while lines scale in to form a list icon, and reverse on second click
Label slides up and fades between the two words
Button background changes to a hover shade while active and scales down on press
editableByProps: Button, hover, icon and label colors

needsCodeEdit.change: Notify the page of the toggle state, for example to switch a real grid/list layout
Change dot positions or number of lines
needsCodeEdit.where: DOTS constant and the [3, 8, 13, 18] array in ToggleIcon

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Both buttons keep their own internal state and are not connected to any external layout
